summary: Compiled TikZ reconstruction of the figure (version 7, critic score 0.90, best version). It shows the top line P-E-D (E on the segment), the vertical EB with a right-angle mark at E, and segments PB, BC and CD. Labels P, E, D, B, C were confirmed visually. The spurious Hough circle was excluded because no arc is visible. Geometry and right-angle placement match the original in all critic reviews.
